notes: Design not named; inferred as country-level descriptive surveillance with a 2015 vs 2019 change (could also be read as ecologic). Averages and percent changes are arithmetic, so no procedures. view_issues: The −8.1% average change in deaths is the mean including the United States (Table 1), whereas the −10.4% rate change excludes it; the text does not flag the difference.
